GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

headings.usage: Used for Item Names, Scenario Titles, Shop Headers. Brings an elegant, geometric, futuristic aesthetic.
headings.styles: Tight tracking (tracking-tight), never default bold. Use font-black for top level, font-light for sub-headers.

body.usage: Crucial for 'The System' aesthetic. Use for all stats, numbers, coin balances, logs, and system notifications.

visual_enhancers.crystal_glassmorphism: System windows MUST use backdrop-blur-xl bg-sky-900/10 border border-sky-400/20. Apply a subtle inset shadow to mimic 3D volume.
visual_enhancers.system_glow: Active items and high-tier (S+) items should utilize a box-shadow glow (e.g., box-shadow: 0 0 20px 5px rgba(56,189,248,0.2)).
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Optional: overlay a repeating-linear-gradient with 1px black lines at 5% opacity to the main background to anchor the LitRPG simulation feel.
visual_enhancers.never_transparent: NEVER use a fully transparent background for any floating element or overlay. Minimum bg-sky-950/80 required for modals.

layouts.player_shop: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid). DO NOT make uniform squares. F-rank items are 1x1, while Star Relics span 2x2. Use gap-6 or gap-8.
layouts.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid Mode B. Tight layout, pure functionality. Data tables for items and users should have clear 1px borders and monospaced data.
layouts.scenarios: Vertical asymmetrical layout. The active scenario is large and dominant (col-span-full), side quests/bounties are tightly packed to the side.

components_instructions.shop_card: A raw div with Tailwind. The image takes the top half with max-h-[250px] object-cover. An absolute positioned 'Rank Badge' overlapping the image edge. Deep padding (p-6) for content.
components_instructions.transaction_log: Monospaced layout. Looks like a server log or system console. Green/Red text for positive/negative transactions.
components_instructions.modals: Purchase confirmation MUST use a heavily customized Shadcn Dialog with no white backgrounds, using the crystal glassmorphism style instead.

motion.hover: Hovering interactive cards adds a crisp -translate-y-1, brightens the border from sky-400/20 to sky-400/60, and increases backdrop blur.
motion.loading: Entrance animations should mimic a 'System Initializing' cascade—staggered fade-up and scale-in.

accessibility.contrast: Text over the deep blue background must be at least sky-100 or white. Use text-shadows when text overlaps images.
accessibility.focus: Elements must show focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-400 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#050A15].

star_relic_placeholder.description: Blue and green dragon sword with white flowers. Use as a default or hero image for high-tier Star Relic items.

coin_hero.description: Pile of ancient gold coins. Use as an ambient background for the DM's 'Grant Coins' section or Player Balance card.

skill_placeholder.description: Abstract glowing green shape. Ideal as a visual representation for Skills and Modifiers in the shop.

dokkaebi_avatar.description: Green mask with horns. Fits the trickster/Dokkaebi aesthetic. Use for the Admin profile or system narrator avatar.

instructions_to_main_agent: The application is a fullstack app with .js files (NO TypeScript .tsx files).
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, high-tech, geometric iconography.
Implement Shadcn/UI for structured Admin tasks but heavily style them away from the default Vercel look to match the Sky Blue ORV theme.
For the Player shop view, rely on raw Tailwind divs and grid manipulation. Avoid Shadcn Cards here to allow for freeform LitRPG styling.
Coin transactions, inventory lists, and scenarios must be prominently displayed. The player should feel immersed in a gamified 'System' UI.
